Accomplishment
1. The Director of Evergreen Senior Class of Irvine Presbyterian Church/CA, A Well-Known Intellectual Activity for T.A. Senior in S. CA

2. Owners & Managers of A Successful Oriental Restaurant in Pensacola/Florida for 22 Years 1980-2001, Promoting Taiwanese Culture & Services in Local Community
